title: Contract Administration: Understanding and Implementing Contractual Obligations
overview: This course is designed to equip participants with the knowledge, skills, and tools necessary to effectively manage and administer contracts post-award. Through this interactive program, participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of the processes and activities required to fulfill contractual obligations successfully. The course also emphasizes best practices in contract administration to ensure optimal performance and partnership between all parties involved.
audience: This course is tailored for professionals involved in the post-award phase of contract implementation, management, and administration. It is particularly beneficial for those seeking to adopt best practices in contract administration.
methodology: The course incorporates individual and group exercises to help participants master the tools and techniques essential for contract implementation. Practical learning is enhanced through case studies, role-playing activities, and group discussions. Additionally, pre- and post-testing is utilized to track learning progress.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Outline the key steps and activities involved in contract administration.
Utilize essential tools and techniques for managing contract implementation and understand the role of a contract administrator.
Develop a system to evaluate contractors, assessing their strengths and weaknesses.
Understand and explain the various types of variation orders, claims, and damages.
Highlight the importance of collaboration and partnership in contract administration.
Prepare for and effectively negotiate contract variations and claims to achieve favorable outcomes.

items.text: Objectives and definitions of contract administration
The contract framework and its purpose
Major steps in the contract administration process
Understanding the contract and its provisions
Tools and techniques for effective contract management:
Roles and responsibilities in contract administration
Developing schedule and risk management plans
Identifying and managing claims and disputes
Understanding breaches of contract and their consequences
Addressing money damages and equitable remedies
Exploring alternative dispute resolution methods (e.g., mediation and arbitration)
Defining and understanding the concept of partnering
